svg.title: Projector Mapper: functional architecture
svg.text: Browser-based projection-mapping tool. Single page, no server or build step: index.html · css/style.css · js/** classic scripts on one PM namespace (runs from GitHub Pages or file://).
Projector Mapper web app (runs entirely in the browser)
IndexedDB · File API · Drag & drop · Clipboard
MP4 / WebM with no computer attached
Every layer = base size + 4 output corners;
move, resize, rotate and warp all edit corners
One project model drives editor, output
Offline-first: no backend, all data local
No dependencies, no build; works from file://
Modules: classic scripts on one PM namespace
